newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Afrique starts weekly fish freighter to Marseille.
newsitem.headline: Air Afrique starts weekly fish freighter to Marseille.

text.p: Pan-African airline, Air Afrique, said it will launch a weekly Boeing 707 freighter charter service between West Africa and Marseille dedicated to carrying to fish shipments, starting this week.

"We have signed a contract with two importers in the Marseille region for a weekly service which we expect to maintain for several months during the West African fishing season," a Marseille-based Air Afrique cargo official told Reuters.
The service will operate from Nouakchott in Mauritania to Dakar and then to Marseille, the official said.
The 'fish' charter will be independent of Air Afrique's existing three times weekly 707F service between Marseille and West Africa, he added.
The 707F has a cargo capacity of between 35 and 40 tonnes per flight. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
